text: A cobalt lantern hangs beneath a cedar arch. A paper moth circles the lantern.
title: Lantern and Paper Moth

text: A glass footbridge crosses a silver canal. Three copper keys rest on the railing.
title: Glass Footbridge

text: A red thread passes through a stone labyrinth. The thread ends beside a white compass.
title: Thread and Compass

text: A cedar boat carries a blue bell across a quiet reservoir. The bell faces an empty pier.
title: Boat and Blue Bell

title: Station Clock
